$description: BIM FURNITURE token category — real manufacturer furniture SKUs and regulatory clearances that DERIVE the Zone 1/2/3 depths in building-width-calculator.dtcg.json. This is the missing foundation: previously zone depths were results with no derivation recorded. Every dimension here traces to a real manufacturer product or a cited regulatory clause. Source: tool-buildingwidth-architecture.md §Missing DTCG token files #1 (2026-05-17, Opus agent research) — Research provenance section. Created 2026-07-03 — this file did not previously exist. Millimetre values are authoritative for furniture/clearance dimensions (matching manufacturer spec-sheet convention); metre values in $description for cross-reference against building-width-calculator.dtcg.json's zone tokens.

office.$description: Shared office furniture SKUs used across Professional Office, Business, and Civic (non-courtroom) zone-depth derivations.

$value.role: Zone 1 Habitat driver — Professional Office, Business, Civic (non-courtroom)

steelcase-ology-desk.$description: Steelcase Ology desk, 762mm (2'6") depth. Zone 1 Habitat driver for Professional Office, Business, and Civic use types.

$value.role: Zone 1 Habitat driver — alternate SKU, same depth as Ology

steelcase-think-desk.$description: Steelcase Think desk, 762mm (2'6") depth. Same depth as Ology — interchangeable for zone-depth derivation purposes.

steelcase-coalesse-round-table.$description: Steelcase Coalesse 3-person round table, 1,067mm (3'6") diameter. Zone 1 Habitat driver for Private Office — see PO-1 Zone 1 depth 5.9944m in building-width-calculator.dtcg.json.

credenza.$description: Credenza, 508mm (1'8") body depth + 600mm (2'0") door swing clearance = 1,108mm combined. Zone 2 Magazine driver.

filing-cabinet.$description: Filing cabinet, 635mm (2'1") body depth + 750mm (2'6") drawer-pull clearance = 1,385mm combined. Zone 2 Magazine driver.

midmark-626-exam-table.$description: Midmark 626 exam table, 790mm (2'7") depth, ADA-compliant. Zone 1 Habitat driver for Medical — see Medical Zone 1 depth 7.2m in building-width-calculator.dtcg.json.

treston-tp915-bench.$description: Treston TP-915 lab bench, 900mm (2'11") depth. Zone 1 Habitat driver for Laboratory — see Laboratory Zone 1 depth 6.7818m in building-width-calculator.dtcg.json.

fume-hood.$description: Fume hood, 940mm (3'1") body depth + 1,500mm (4'11") egress clearance = 2,440mm combined. Zone 2 Magazine driver for Laboratory.

tablet-arm-chair-row.$description: Tablet-arm chair, 965mm (3'2") row-to-row pitch. Zone 1 Habitat driver for Academic — see Academic Zone 1 depth 4.7m in building-width-calculator.dtcg.json (4 rows × pitch, forward-facing seating, not façade-facing).

civic.$description: Civic Office furniture SKUs (courtroom-specific; non-courtroom Civic spaces use bim.furniture.office).

$value.role: Zone 1 Habitat driver — Civic courtroom variant

agati-judges-bench.$description: Agati judges bench, 1,200mm (3'11") depth. Zone 1 Habitat driver for Civic courtroom specialisation.

clearance.$description: Regulatory clearance and circulation dimensions cited in zone-depth derivations. Each cites its governing code/standard.

arbstattv-workstation.$description: 3'3" — ArbStättV (German workplace ordinance) Anhang §3.1 movement clearance behind a seated workstation.

asr-a18-corridor-aisle-20person.$description: 3'3" — ASR A1.8 (German workplace rule, traffic routes) Tabelle 2, aisle width for occupancy ≤20 persons. This is the one ASR A1.8 tier this workspace has a confirmed source value for; the full multi-tier table (by occupant count) is not reproduced here — do not assume other occupancy tiers without a source.

ada-wheelchair-turn.$description: 5'0" — ADA 2010 §305 wheelchair turning-radius clearance. Also cited by CSA-B651 for the Canadian equivalent.

ibc-egress-laboratory.$description: 10'0" — IBC 2021 §1020/§1029 egress-width minimum for high-hazard (laboratory) occupancy. Matches Laboratory Zone 3 Corridor width in building-width-calculator.dtcg.json — this is the IBC citation for that value, not a separate independent figure.

ibc-egress-civic-assembly.$description: 11'10" — IBC 2021 §1020/§1029 egress-width minimum for assembly (civic/public) occupancy. Matches Civic Zone 3 Corridor width in building-width-calculator.dtcg.json — this is the IBC citation for that value, not a separate independent figure. Only these two occupancy classes (laboratory high-hazard, civic assembly) have confirmed IBC citations in this workspace; a full occupancy-class table is not reproduced here.

en12464-workstation-to-window.$description: 19'8" — EN 12464-1:2021 + EN 17037 maximum workstation-to-window distance (2.4m window head × 2.5). This is the regulatory cap that sets Professional Office/Business/Civic Zone 1 Habitat depth at exactly 6.0m.

derivation-example.$description: Worked example showing how bim.furniture + bim.clearance tokens sum to the Professional Office Zone 1 Habitat depth (6.0m) already present in building-width-calculator.dtcg.json. Encodes the derivation cited in tool-buildingwidth-architecture.md §Missing DTCG token files #1 so tool-buildingwidth's --derive-from-furniture mode has a machine-readable reference calculation.

terms.note: EN 17037 daylight buffer, derived: 2.4m window head × 2.5 minus the desk+clearance terms above, NOT the raw 6.0m cap value itself — see caveat

$value.caveat: The fourth term (1.714m) is presented in tool-buildingwidth-architecture.md as 'EN 17037 daylight buffer (2.4m window head × 2.5)' summing the four terms to exactly 6.000m. The arithmetic (2.286 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 1.714 = 6.0) is confirmed; the derivation of 1.714m specifically from '2.4m × 2.5' is not (2.4 × 2.5 = 6.0, not 1.714) — this term is better read as 'the remainder after desk + two clearances, independently corroborated by the EN 12464-1 6.0m cap' rather than a direct product of the cited factors. Flagging rather than silently reproducing an arithmetic claim that doesn't check out at face value.

professional-office-zone1.$description: Professional Office Zone 1 derivation: 3× Steelcase Ology desk (2.286m) + ArbStättV clearance (1.0m) + ASR A1.8 aisle (1.0m) + daylight buffer (1.714m) = 6.000m. See $value.caveat for a flagged arithmetic note on the fourth term.
